title: European Search Perspective
byline: Prof. Dr. Felix Biessmann  Berlin University of Applied Science & Einstein Center Digital Future
excerpt: Promoting digital pluralism, data security, and sustainability through a European Web Index.

Creating a new foundation for digital pluralism, data security and sustainability

EUROPEAN SEARCH PERSPECTIVE is building a European web index, i.e. a comprehensive directory of websites and digital content hosted in Europe. This index will be an alternative results provider for a diverse set of small search engines, startups and the European Data / AI industry.

Contact

Our Mission

We believe in plurality and diversity of thought.

We believe in the power of competition and choice.

We believe in digital sovereignty.

We believe in data security and privacy.

We believe in sustainability and the need to make this planet a better place for our children.

We believe in a EUROPEAN SEARCH PERSPECTIVE.

Did you know this?

About 99% of all search queries in Europe are answered by just two companies, both of them US-based. The remainder is supplied by a Russian state-owned company. All other relevant search engines are run on data from the above.

Technological dependency of the European digital economy is massive. New AI technologies need huge amounts of data, often including a large web index. Today, they need to reach out to their competitors for access.

We face significant challenges in today's digital landscape, including inadequate data security, insufficient privacy protection and environmentally unsustainable practices.

Solution: New Web Index ”European Search Perspective“

Search engines face the challenge of prioritizing results. Our European search ranking algorithm will facilitate this process, enabling smaller search engines to offer diverse perspectives to their users. Additionally, they will have the flexibility to tailor their services to specific target audiences. This will also be an important resource for technology startups, especially in the field of AI, who not want to depend on their much larger competitors for data.

Application Fields

Search Engines

The EUSP Web Index and Ranking Algorithm can be syndicated by any search engine, delivering secure and sustainable data infrastructure.

AI Tech Development

The EUSP data can be used for development of European AI products, providing an independent and secure data basis for training purposes.

Joint Venture with Success-Proven Tech Expertise

European Search Perspective is a Joint Venture of Europe‘s two leading search engines, Ecosia and Qwant

Ecosia (Germany)

  • The search engine that plants trees
  • 20 million users
  • Already planted more than 216 million trees in 35 countries
  • A strong brand and Europe’s biggest search engine

Qwant (France)

  • The search engine that values you as a user, not as a product
  • 6 million users
  • No storage of search history, no resale of personal data
  • No tracking of searches

Acknowledgements

“Internet search has profound societal impact and a web index is an essential prerequisite for many AI technologies. An independent European web index can help to build trust in digital technologies and is an important alternative for users as well as local talent in data engineering and AI.”

“We’re excited to see the launch of this new web index. At System1, we support innovations in search, and we look forward to exploring the potential of becoming a customer as the project develops.”

Michael Blend CEO & Co-Founder, System1

“New ventures cannot rely on the goodwill of their incumbent competitors. Europe needs diverse and sovereign data markets if it wants to compete in the emerging AI industry.”

Tim Schumacher Internet Entrepreneur & Investor

FAQ

We are building a European web index, i.e. a comprehensive directory of websites and digital content. This index can be syndicated by search engines and serve as a key resource for the European data industry, e.g. providing a transparent and secure data pool for new AI technologies. In this way, we want to offer companies and citizens a new foundation that leads to more pluralism, security and souvereignty in the digital world.

A web index is a large database in which information about websites and their content is stored. The aim is to enable users to search and find content on the internet quickly and easily. Storing and updating an index of the entire internet is very expensive and complex. It requires constant updating by web crawlers that scour the internet for new websites and collect information about their content.

Today, Europe receives 99% of the answers to search queries from external infrastructures. We believe, however, that a higher level of digital sovereignty is essential for a functioning democracy and economy. With our new web index, we are creating a European perspective on politics, culture and values. This is a long overdue step towards more plurality in the digital world, which is also being called for by our society.

European Search Perspective is a joint venture of the biggest two European search engines Ecosia and Qwant.

Ecosia, based in Germany, operates a green search engine with over 20 million users. 100% of its profits are used for climate action, with the majority going into tree-planting projects around the world. This makes Ecosia the largest tree-planting movement in the world.

Qwant is based in France and affiliated to Europe's largest cloud provider OVH. It operates the biggest French search engine and is the preferred supplier to the French government due to its spike on data protection.

Yes, European Search Perspective is independent of any political party or institution. We believe that a plurality of suppliers is necessary for diversity and plurality of thought - across national, party political and organizational borders.

The joint venture is funded by the private companies Ecosia and Qwant.

We aim to deliver initial results in summer 2025. European Search Perspective will start as a partial web index in France and Germany.

We are convinced that more competition and diversity in the digital world will benefit all people, organizations and market participants.

We offer users an alternative web index that is hosted in Europe, prioritizes data protection, and enables freedom of choice.

We support digital sovereignty for the European economy and reduce its data dependence on a few foreign companies, especially when it comes to developing future technologies such as AI.

We create more competition for all market participants, which will lead to greater innovation.

Please feel free to send us a message. We look forward to answering your questions and entering into a dialog with you.

为数字多元化、数据安全和可持续性奠定新的基础

EUROPEAN SEARCH PERSPECTIVE 正在构建欧洲网络索引，即欧洲托管的网站和数字内容的综合目录。 该索引将成为各种小型搜索引擎、初创公司和欧洲数据/人工智能行业的替代结果提供者。

接触

我们的使命

我们相信思想的多元化和多样性。

我们相信竞争和选择的力量。

我们相信数字主权。

我们相信数据安全和隐私。

我们相信可持续发展，并相信有必要为我们的孩子们创造一个更美好的星球。

我们相信欧洲搜索的视角。

你知道吗？

欧洲大约 99% 的搜索查询仅由两家公司回答，这两家公司都位于美国。 其余部分由俄罗斯国有公司提供。 所有其他相关搜索引擎均根据上述数据运行。

欧洲数字经济对技术的依赖程度很高。 新的人工智能技术需要大量数据，通常包括大型网络索引。 如今，他们需要联系竞争对手以获得访问权限。

在当今的数字环境中，我们面临着重大挑战，包括数据安全性不足、隐私保护不足以及环境不可持续的做法。

解决方案：新网络索引“欧洲搜索视角”

搜索引擎面临着确定结果优先级的挑战。 我们的欧洲搜索排名算法将促进这一过程，使较小的搜索引擎能够为其用户提供多样化的视角。 此外，他们还可以灵活地针对特定目标受众定制服务。 这也将成为技术初创公司的重要资源，特别是在人工智能领域，因为它们不想依赖更大的竞争对手获取数据。

应用领域

搜索引擎

EUSP 网络索引和排名算法可以由任何搜索引擎联合，提供安全且可持续的数据基础设施。

人工智能技术开发

EUSP数据可用于欧洲人工智能产品的开发，为培训目的提供独立、安全的数据基础。

拥有经过成功验证的技术专长的合资企业

Europe Search Perspective 是欧洲两大领先搜索引擎 Ecosia 和 Qwant 的合资企业

生态西亚（德国）

  • 植树的搜索引擎
  • 2000万用户
  • 已在 35 个国家种植了超过 2.16 亿棵树
  • 强大的品牌和欧洲最大的搜索引擎

Qwant（法国）

  • 搜索引擎将您视为用户，而不是产品
  • 600万用户
  • 不存储搜索历史记录，不转售个人数据
  • 不跟踪搜索

致谢

“互联网搜索具有深远的社会影响，网络索引是许多人工智能技术的重要先决条件。 独立的欧洲网络索引可以帮助建立对数字技术的信任，对于用户以及数据工程和人工智能领域的本地人才来说是一个重要的选择。”

“我们很高兴看到这个新网络索引的推出。 在 System1，我们支持搜索创新，并期待随着项目的发展探索成为客户的潜力。”

Michael Blend System1 首席执行官兼联合创始人

“新企业不能依赖现有竞争对手的商誉。 如果欧洲想要在新兴的人工智能行业中竞争，就需要多元化和主权的数据市场。”

蒂姆·舒马赫互联网企业家和投资者

FAQ

我们正在建立欧洲网络索引，即网站和数字内容的综合目录。 该索引可以由搜索引擎联合并作为欧洲数据行业的关键资源，例如为新的人工智能技术提供透明、安全的数据池。 通过这种方式，我们希望为企业和公民提供一个新的基础，从而在数字世界中实现更加多元化、安全和主权。

网络索引是一个大型数据库，其中存储有关网站及其内容的信息。 目的是使用户能够快速、轻松地在互联网上搜索和查找内容。 存储和更新整个互联网的索引非常昂贵且复杂。 它需要网络爬虫不断更新，在互联网上搜索新网站并收集有关其内容的信息。

如今，欧洲 99% 的搜索查询答案都是来自外部基础设施。 然而，我们认为，更高水平的数字主权对于民主和经济的正常运转至关重要。 通过我们新的网络索引，我们正在创建一个关于政治、文化和价值观的欧洲视角。 这是迈向数字世界更加多元化的迟来的一步，这也是我们社会的呼吁。

Europe Search Perspective 是欧洲最大的两家搜索引擎 Ecosia 和 Qwant 的合资企业。

Ecosia 总部位于德国，运营着一个拥有超过 2000 万用户的绿色搜索引擎。 其100%的利润用于气候行动，其中大部分用于世界各地的植树项目。 这使得 Ecosia 成为世界上最大的植树运动。

Qwant 总部位于法国，隶属于欧洲最大的云提供商 OVH。 它运营着法国最大的搜索引擎，并且由于其在数据保护方面的激增而成为法国政府的首选供应商。

是的，欧洲搜索视角独立于任何政党或机构。 我们相信，多元化的供应商对于跨越国家、政党政治和组织边界的多元化和多元化思想是必要的。

该合资企业由私营公司 Ecosia 和 Qwant 资助。

我们的目标是在 2025 年夏季取得初步结果。 欧洲搜索视角将首先在法国和德国作为部分网络索引。

我们相信，数字世界中更多的竞争和多样性将使所有人、组织和市场参与者受益。

我们为用户提供在欧洲托管的替代网络索引，优先考虑数据保护并实现选择自由。

我们支持欧洲经济的数字主权，并减少其对少数外国公司的数据依赖，特别是在开发人工智能等未来技术方面。

我们为所有市场参与者创造更多竞争，这将带来更大的创新。
